overview.description: The Defiance Daily Target 2x Short RGTI ETF (RGTZ) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund seeks to provide -200% exposure of the daily price change in the share price of Rigetti Computing (RGTI), less fees and expenses. The fund uses swaps to create the leveraged, inverse exposure. RGTZ was launched on Oct 8, 2025 and is issued by Defiance.
